text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
I made some of my special miso<n>soup, and you
just gotta try it!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Oh, El! Mmm, what an excellent<n>present! I will
accept your kind offer!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
But first, I need to know—how much<n>passion did
you put into this miso<n>soup of yours?

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Is chock-full of spicy miso! I call it,<n>Fiery Passion
Miso Soup!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Mmm... very goooood! I'd expect<n>nothing less, El!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Your gift promises to show me the<n>cutting edge of
miso soup—a new<n>horizon filled with countless
possibilities! I can't wait to dig in!
